name: WordPress plugin
h1: Privacy policy for WordPress plugin developers
metaTitle: WordPress Plugin Privacy Policy — Guideline 7 & Suggested Policy Text | PrivacyPage
metaDescription: For plugin authors, not site owners: WordPress.org Guideline 7 bans tracking without consent, and core lets you suggest privacy policy text with wp_add_privacy_policy_content.
answer: If you publish a plugin on WordPress.org, Guideline 7 says plugins may not track users without their consent, so any usage tracking or phoning home must be opt-in. WordPress also lets your plugin suggest privacy policy text to site owners with wp_add_privacy_policy_content. If your plugin sends data to your own service, publish a privacy policy for it.

storeRule.title: Detailed Plugin Guidelines — Guideline 7
storeRule.quote: Plugins may not track users without their consent.

additionalRules.title: Suggest text for the site’s policy
additionalRules.text: WordPress’s Plugin Handbook: this “is best done with wp_add_privacy_policy_content( $plugin_name, $policy_text )” so site administrators can pull it into their own privacy policy.

additionalRules.title: Answer the default questions
additionalRules.text: The handbook says the suggested text should address the questions in the default privacy policy, starting with “What personal data we collect and why we collect it”.

sdks.name: Typical plugin data flows
dataCollected: Site URL and WordPress/PHP versions (usage tracking, opt-in only)
Form submissions sent to a third-party API
License keys and admin email for updates

whereToPaste: Your plugin’s own site: a privacy policy covering any data your servers receive.
Inside the plugin: register suggested text with wp_add_privacy_policy_content on admin_init.
readme.txt: say what is sent externally and link the policy.

sampleClause.heading: Usage data (opt-in)
sampleClause.text: If you choose Allow usage tracking in the plugin settings, the plugin sends your site URL, WordPress version, PHP version and active theme to our server once a week. Nothing is sent unless you opt in, and you can turn it off at any time.

faqs.q: Can my WordPress plugin collect usage data?
faqs.a: Only with the user’s consent. Guideline 7 forbids tracking users without consent, so make it opt-in and disclose it.

faqs.q: Is this for site owners who want a privacy policy plugin?
faqs.a: No. This page is for plugin authors. Site owners can still generate a website policy with PrivacyPage.
